verification_result: Legacy login page 'Forgot Password'; the SPA has no login page - password reset belongs to the Keycloak realm.
related_issues: IQSS/dataverse-frontend#652 ('Keycloak theming - Login page', CLOSED as completed) and #930 ('Add Warning Message to Login page', CLOSED) establish that the SPA has no login page of its own by design - authentication is delegated to a Keycloak page that the SPA itself themes (src/keycloak-theme/). #868 (closed) covers builtin-user login issues in the SPA.
notes: ARCHITECTURAL CHANGE, not a missing feature: the SPA authenticates exclusively via OIDC and ships its own Keycloak login theme, so this legacy login-page/account-management affordance has moved to the identity provider and is a per-install Keycloak configuration concern rather than SPA work. Verified: the SPA header's only anonymous action is an OIDC Log In button (Header.tsx) which redirects to the Keycloak realm sign-in page; this install's Keycloak form offers only username/password with no register or forgot-password links, which is Keycloak config. Not filed locally. The one genuine SPA-side gap in this cluster, the missing header Sign Up entry, is filed as jp-tosca/dv-modern-fc#10.
